name: Chantal Akerman

films.title: Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
films.overview: A lonely young widow lives with her son following an immutable order: while the boy is in school, she cares for their apartment, does chores, and receives clients in the afternoon.

films.title: The Captive
films.overview: Ariane lives with Simon in his large Paris flat. Simon is obsessed with her: he wants to know everything about her, secretly follows her when she goes out, asks questions all the time, even in the most intimate moments. Ariane seems to take it all in stride, but Simon realises that she's hiding something.

films.title: Blow Up My Town
films.overview: Suburbs of Brussels. A young woman locks herself in the kitchen of her apartment, as she blissfully devotes herself to dismantling the household chores, frenetically humming as she goes. A burlesque pamphlet against female alienation.

films.title: The Meetings of Anna
films.overview: Detached filmmaker Anna Silver arrives in Germany to show her latest film; over the course of some days, she encounters a variety of new and old faces, some of whom make personal revelations to her to little affect.

films.title: Je Tu Il Elle
films.overview: A woman suffers a subdued psychological breakdown in the wake of a devastating breakup.

films.title: News from Home
films.overview: Impersonal and beautiful images of Akerman's life in New York are combined with letters from her loving but manipulative mother, read by Akerman herself.
